entry.description: A single game's entry: save locations plus optional store IDs and aliases. Only files is required; unknown keys are rejected.

aliases.description: Alternative titles that resolve to this entry after matching. A matching feature, not metadata.

files.description: Save file locations per platform. Every entry must have at least one platform key.

store_ids.description: Store identifiers used to match a detected game by store. Optional; entries without store_ids are matched by title only.

files.description: Save locations per platform. Paths are glob strings using {Documents}, {LocalAppData}, {LocalLow}, {AppData}, {SteamUserData} and {GameRoot} placeholders.

linux.description: Save paths on Linux. Entries for native Linux games may have only this key and no windows paths.

steam.description: Steam app ID, matching the u32 type used in src/gamedb.rs.

paths.description: One or more glob paths. Use {Documents}, {LocalAppData}, {LocalLow}, {AppData}, {SteamUserData} or {GameRoot} for well-known directories.
